You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-005: Interest transaction record contents

### given[0] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The transaction sequence counter (an unsigned 6-digit number) goes up by 1 before each interest transaction is built.

### when[0]: The transaction ID is the 10-character run date parameter followed by the 6-digit sequence counter (with leading zeros), 16 characters in total.
fields=['TRAN-ID', 'PARM-DATE', 'WS-TRANID-SUFFIX'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   473        1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   474            ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
   475 
>> 476            STRING PARM-DATE,
>> 477                   WS-TRANID-SUFFIX
>> 478              DELIMITED BY SIZE
>> 479              INTO TRAN-ID
>> 480            END-STRING.
   481 
   482            MOVE '01'                 TO TRAN-TYPE-CD
   483            MOVE '05'                 TO TRAN-CAT-CD
   484            MOVE 'System'             TO TRAN-SOURCE
CBACT04C.cbl:
   169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
>> 173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
>> 174 
>> 175        LINKAGE SECTION.
>> 176        01  EXTERNAL-PARMS.
>> 177            05  PARM-LENGTH         PIC S9(04) COMP.
>> 178            05  PARM-DATE           PIC X(10).
   179       *****************************************************************
   180        PROCEDURE DIVISION USING EXTERNAL-PARMS.
   181            DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT04C'.
   182            PERFORM 0000-TCATBALF-OPEN.
CVTRA05Y.cpy:
     1       *****************************************************************
     2       *    Data-structure for TRANsaction record (RECLN = 350)
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  TRAN-RECORD.
>>   5            05  TRAN-ID                                 PIC X(16).
     6            05  TRAN-TYPE-CD                            PIC X(02).
     7            05  TRAN-CAT-CD                             PIC 9(04).
     8            05  TRAN-SOURCE                             PIC X(10).
     9            05  TRAN-DESC                               PIC X(100).

### then[0] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): Type code is set to '01' and category code to '05'. The category code is a 4-digit numeric field, so it holds 0005. Source is set to 'System'.

### then[1] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The description is the text 'Int. for a/c ' followed by the 11-digit account ID.

### then[2] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The amount is the computed monthly interest. Merchant ID is set to 0, and merchant name, city and zip are set to spaces.

### then[3] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): The card number is copied from the card cross-reference record found for the account.

### then[4] (already verified; context only, no verdict needed): Origination and processing timestamps both get the same current date and time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000 (hundredths of a second followed by '0000').

### then[5]: The record is added as a new 350-byte record (a 16-byte ID plus 334 bytes of data) to the sequential transaction output file.
fields=['FD-TRANFILE-REC', 'TRAN-RECORD'] literals=['SEQUENTIAL']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   496            PERFORM Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP
   497            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-ORIG-TS
   498            MOVE DB2-FORMAT-TS        TO TRAN-PROC-TS
   499 
>> 500            WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC FROM TRAN-RECORD
   501            IF  TRANFILE-STATUS   = '00'
   502                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   503            ELSE
   504                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
CBACT04C.cbl:
    49                   ACCESS MODE  IS RANDOM
    50                   RECORD KEY   IS FD-DISCGRP-KEY
    51                   FILE STATUS  IS DISCGRP-STATUS.
    52 
>>  53            SELECT TRANSACT-FILE ASSIGN TO TRANSACT
>>  54                   ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
>>  55                   ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL
>>  56                   FILE STATUS  IS TRANFILE-STATUS.
    57 
    58       *
    59        DATA DIVISION.
    60        FILE SECTION.
CBACT04C.cbl:
    85        01  FD-ACCTFILE-REC.
    86            05 FD-ACCT-ID                        PIC 9(11).
    87            05 FD-ACCT-DATA                      PIC X(289).
    88 
>>  89        FD  TRANSACT-FILE.
>>  90        01  FD-TRANFILE-REC.
>>  91            05 FD-TRANS-ID                       PIC X(16).
>>  92            05 FD-ACCT-DATA                      PIC X(334).
    93 
    94        WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
    95 
    96       *****************************************************************

Give verdicts only for the clauses that are not marked already verified.
